Historical examination

UExcel historical examinations

Retired for new examinations since August 21, 2022. Preserve prior earned results, but do not recommend this as a future earning option.

Historical resource · do not treat as a current enrollment offer

How the credit works

Historical Excelsior examination credit; existing results may be evaluated for transfer.

Pace and learning format

No new exam scheduling; historical transcript retrieval only.

Costs to check

No current exam price. Check applicable historical transcript-request charges rather than old examination fees.

Check the current checkout terms and the costs that apply to your actual course list. Membership time, assessments, materials, retakes, transcripts, and school fees may need separate attention.

Assessments and requirements

Use the official prior-result transcript route; there are no new UExcel assessments.

Before you commit

  • Identify the exact course or examination, completion date, and original transcript source.
  • Ask your receiving school how it evaluates this historical learning.
  • Do not assume an old recommendation or agreement remains available for new study.
